Subject: Redwood Inference pricing deck & next steps

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Goal: reduce inference cost and latency for customer-facing chat by ~40% while keeping output quality consistent.
- Current pain: high token spend and request variability during peak hours; caching and batching not centralized.
- Key stakeholders: Product (you), ML infra, and procurement.

I attached a tailored pricing estimate and a short implementation checklist: Redwood-Pricing-LumenWorks-Estimate.pdf (estimate + three deployment options) and Redwood-Implementation-Checklist.xlsx.

Suggested next steps:
1) Quick 20–30 minute walkthrough of the deck so I can answer any questions and align on sizing assumptions.
2) If that looks good, we can pull in Marissa for an SOW/ops checklist and loop in procurement.

You can grab time on my calendar here: https://calendly.com/ben-carter/20min — I’m happy to work around your schedule.

If you didn’t get the attachment or want a different format (slide deck), I can resend.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
